title: Original finish gate and track window
summary: Race laps now count using the original finish-gate test; the on-track route window is the original 200ft both ways.
details:
Changed: race laps now count the way the original RaceStatus does: when a rider's motion crosses the course's finish gate line (TDF tag 16 box, gate test 001a95b0) while the rider was less than 200ft before the gate. The on-track route window is the original 200ft both ways (Track constructor 00179330), replacing the authored 150ft/60ft. TDF tag 41 Track flags are read: flag 4 makes the first gate pass only arm the rider (sx06, sx11, sx16 start 700–1,860ft before the gate), flag 8 keeps the first lap out of Best Lap (all 32 courses).

Discoveries: the finish "box" is really a gate line across the track from center minus to center plus its half extents; passing beside the gate counts nothing; all 32 race TDFs set flag 8, five set flag 4.

Verification: atv-core tests (512 pass) incl. new gate/flag unit tests; private test driving a two-lap race on all 32 original courses finishes each at the second counted gate crossing and keeps all 60 alternate lines in order; browser test test_engine_race_finish_gate.mjs on SX06 (CPUs past the gate once have 0 laps, past it twice have 1); test_engine_race, race_grid and race_gear browser tests pass. Host Chromium only, not a verified public release.
limitation: On env07 and sx13 the start row sits ~20ft past the gate with flag 4 set; the port treats the skip as already used there (assumption, not established from the exact build). CPU steering keeps its authored projection window. No whole-race PS2 replay comparison.
caption: SX06 Supercross race at 1:45 in host Chromium: lap counting now follows the original finish-gate test.
